failed.body: The niri-mirror daemon reported no details.
failed.title: Screen Mirror failed

missing.body: The bundled mirroring engine (engine/niri_mirror.py) is missing; reinstall the plugin, or install niri-mirror (https://github.com/Goldppx/niri-mirror) and re-enable it.
missing.title: Screen Mirror is not installed

enabled_on_start.description: Start the daemon with mirroring on. Turn off if you only want to mirror after pressing the toggle. The off state does not survive a logout: mirroring always starts from this value.
enabled_on_start.label: Enabled on start

excluded_outputs.description: Connector names that never get a mirror window, not even when plugged in, one per entry (e.g. HDMI-A-1). Run `niri-mirror --list-outputs` to see the names; partial names like `hdmi` are accepted.
excluded_outputs.label: Excluded displays

poll_interval.description: How often the tile and widget re-read the daemon state file. The daemon itself follows niri's event stream, so this only affects the UI.
poll_interval.label: Refresh interval (ms)

scaling.description: How wl-mirror fits the source onto the mirrored display.
scaling.label: Scaling

show_osd.description: Show the shell OSD (or a notification) whenever mirroring is switched on or off, including toggles done with a keybind.
show_osd.label: Show OSD feedback

source_output.description: Connector to mirror from. Leave empty to use the focused display at startup (and re-elect when it disappears). Run `niri-mirror --list-outputs` to see the names; partial names like `hdmi` are accepted.
source_output.label: Source display
